title: Here’s Where to Watch ‘Forever Young: A Grammy Salute to Rod Stewart Live’ Online
summary: The music celebration broadcasts coast-to-coast on Tuesday (May 19).
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The Recording Academy pays tribute to a pop-rock legend with the TV special, Forever Young: A Grammy Salute to Rod Stewart Live . It celebrates the musical and cultural impact of the Grammy winner over the last six decades of Stewart’s career.

The two-hour event was filmed in February at Hard Rock Live (inside of the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino) in Hollywood, Florida and airs on Tuesday (May 19).

How to Watch Forever Young: A Grammy Salute to Rod Stewart Live Online, At a Glance:

- Date: Tuesday, May 19

- Start time: 8 p.m. ET/PT

- TV channel: CBS

- Livestream: DirecTV , Paramount+ , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV

Watch with DirecTV

When Does Forever Young: A Grammy Salute to Rod Stewart Live Start ?

The two-hour TV special Forever Young: A Grammy Salute to Rod Stewart Live broadcasts on CBS , with an airtime of 8 p.m. ET/PT. It also livestreams on Paramount+.

Where to Watch  Forever Young: A Grammy Salute to Rod Stewart Live Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch Forever Young: A Grammy Salute to Rod Stewart Live , especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , offer a free trial so you can watch CBS for free.

Keep reading for more details on how to watch the TV special online.
